description: Run a Sling YAML replication as Dagster assets via dagster-sling.

outputs.description: One or more replicated tables materialized via Sling -- no data passed through the IO manager.

replication_config_path.description: Path to a Sling replication YAML file (relative to project root, or absolute).
replication_config_path.label: Replication Config Path

group_name.description: Asset group applied to every stream in the replication.
group_name.label: Group Name

name.description: Op name for the replication run.
name.label: Name

emit_incremental_watermarks.label: Emit Incremental Watermarks
emit_incremental_watermarks.description: For streams configured with Sling's `mode: incremental` and an `update_key`, query the target table's MAX(update_key) after each materialization and attach it as asset metadata (`incremental_watermark`, `update_key`). Sling has no separate per-stream state file by default -- the target table is its state -- so this surfaces the same watermark value Sling itself would use as the next run's starting point.

name: SlingReplicationAsset
